title: 第1306章 人前显圣第1305章 金色养魂树
content_zh:
此刻倒悬山炼器殿中，云歌正端坐殿内，潜心打磨傀儡机关。
数十年沉淀打磨，她的傀儡术造诣，再度精进一层，手法愈发娴熟，纹路刻画愈发精准，阵法布局愈发完善。
如今的她，已经掌握炼制高仿傀儡的完整手法。
炼制出的傀儡，身形、神态、气息、动作，与活人别无二致，足以以假乱真，寻常修士根本无法分辨真伪。
正当她专心炼制傀儡之时，心底忽然生出感应，敏锐捕捉到熟悉的气息波动。
她神色骤亮，眼底浮出明显喜色，立刻放下手中的炼器器具，起身冲出炼器殿，伫立山巅，朝着南边空域眺望。
视线尽头，一道青色流光破空疾驰，速度极快，转瞬千里。
数个呼吸之间，流光落地，一道挺拔身姿，稳稳伫立在云歌身前。
正是专程赶来青山巡查的陈平。
时隔六十年再见师尊，云歌心境微动，脸颊浮出浅淡红晕，一时心绪纷乱，愣在原地，不知该作何言语。
陈平看着少女拘谨局促的模样，唇角微扬，淡然开口。
"怎么，为师不能来？"
云歌连忙回过神，双手快速摆动，出声辩解。
"不是，我不是这个意思！"
陈平见状，不再刻意打趣，收敛笑意，正色吩咐。
"行了，不逗你玩了。即刻传令下去，召集青山所有核心弟子、门下徒孙，齐聚大殿。"
"今日，为师亲自查验众人六十年修行成果。"
青山洞天的核心主殿，修建在倒悬山之巅，占地面积极广，阵法笼罩四方，威严厚重，灵气充盈。
整座大殿以天外灵玉，千年铁木，炼器精金搭建而成，格局规整，气场雄浑，是青山势力最高规格的议事，修行，考核场地。
陈平端坐大殿主位，身姿挺拔，神色平和，目光缓缓扫过大殿之内的所有人。

六十年岁月更迭，青山势力人员规模，大幅扩张。
如今宗门核心修行弟子，共计三十余人。
人群之中，不少面孔极为陌生，都是近数十年从小世界选拔，新晋拜入山门的新生代弟子，是他未曾见过的徒孙辈后辈。
这些新生代弟子，尽数拜在单于、萧风、罗鹃、熊初墨、王发等核心手下门下。
一众弟子之中，萧风门下的三名新徒，格外引人注目。
陈平目光重点落在三人身上，细细观察神态气场，根骨底蕴。
三人之中，为首的青年身姿挺拔，眉目凌厉，神态倨傲。
这份傲气，并非浅薄张狂，而是源自骨子里的自信，是对自身天赋，自身前路的绝对笃定。
content_en:
At this moment, in the Weapon Refining Hall of Hanging Mountain, Yunge was sitting upright, concentrating on polishing the puppet mechanism.
After decades of hard work, her puppetry skills have improved to a new level, her techniques have become more proficient, her textures have become more precise, and her formations have become more complete.
Now, she has mastered the complete technique of refining high imitation puppets.
The body shape, expression, breath, and movements of the refined puppet are exactly the same as those of living people. They are enough to look fake and real. Ordinary monks cannot tell the difference between real and fake.
While she was concentrating on refining the puppet, she suddenly felt a sensation in her heart and keenly caught the familiar aura fluctuations.
Her expression suddenly brightened, and there was obvious joy in her eyes. She immediately put down the weapon refining tools in her hands, stood up and rushed out of the weapon refining hall, stood on the top of the mountain, and looked towards the southern airspace.
At the end of the line of sight, a stream of cyan light streaked through the sky at extremely fast speeds, traveling thousands of miles in the blink of an eye.
Within a few breaths, the stream of light fell to the ground, and a tall figure stood steadily in front of Yunge.
It was Chen Ping who made a special trip to Qingshan for inspection.
Seeing his master again after sixty years, Yun Ge felt slightly moved, with a light blush on his cheeks. He was confused and froze in place, not knowing what to say.
Chen Ping looked at the girl's reserved appearance, raised the corners of his lips slightly, and spoke calmly.
"Why, I can't come as a teacher?"
Yun Ge quickly came to his senses, moved his hands quickly, and defended himself.
"No, that's not what I meant!"
When Chen Ping saw this, he stopped joking, suppressed his smile, and gave serious instructions.
"Okay, I won't tease you anymore. Send an order immediately to summon all the core disciples and disciples of Qingshan to gather in the main hall."
"Today, I will personally inspect the results of everyone's sixty years of cultivation."
The core main hall of Qingshan Cave Sky is built on the top of the hanging mountain. It covers an extremely large area and the formation covers all directions. It is majestic and full of spiritual energy.
The entire hall is made of heavenly jade, thousand-year-old ironwood, and refined gold. It has a regular layout and a powerful aura. It is the highest-level forum for discussion, practice, and assessment of the Qingshan forces.
Chen Ping sat in the main seat of the hall, with a tall and straight posture and a peaceful expression, his eyes slowly sweeping over everyone in the hall.
Sixty years have passed, and the size of Qingshan's forces has expanded significantly.
Currently, there are more than thirty core disciples of the sect.
Among the crowd, many faces were extremely unfamiliar. They were the new generation of disciples who had been selected from the Small World in recent decades and newly promoted to the mountain sect. They were the descendants of his disciples and grandchildren that he had never seen before.
These new generation disciples all worshiped under the core disciples such as Shan Yu, Xiao Feng, Luo Juan, Xiong Chumo, and Wang Fa.
Among the disciples, the three new disciples of Xiao Feng's sect are particularly eye-catching.
Chen Ping focused his attention on the three of them, carefully observing their demeanor, aura, and fundamentals.
Among the three people, the young man leading the group was tall and straight, with sharp eyebrows and an arrogant expression.
This arrogance is not superficial and arrogant, but comes from the self-confidence in the bones. It is the absolute determination of one's own talent and one's own future.
